ENGLISH — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 1.5.1 Writing legibly and neatly.

2. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Polite Language: Telephone Etiquette.

3. When practising Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Sounds: vowels /ɑː/ /зː/and consonants /tʃ/ and/dʒ/ 9.1.1.2: Stressed and unstre.

4. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. One main idea with supporting sentences
   B. No full stops
   C. Many unrelated topics with no link
   D. Only one word repeated

5. When practising Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.2.1Extensive Reading: Independent Reading.

6. When practising Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 2.2.1 Intensive Reading: Simple poems.

7. When practising Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 1.3.1 Word classes: Compound Nouns.

8. When practising Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

9. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. quickly
   B. run
   C. happiness
   D. blue

10. When practising Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 2.1.1 Oral Presentations: Songs.

11. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

12. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. Only a joining word
   C. A person, place, thing, or idea
   D. Only an action

13. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. going
   B. goed
   C. went
   D. goes

14. When practising : Stressed and unstressed words, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to : Stressed and unstressed words.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for : Stressed and unstressed words.
   C. Use insults to “practise” : Stressed and unstressed words.
   D. Copy random text without understanding : Stressed and unstressed words.

15. When practising Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading 1.4.1 Intensive Reading: Short Stories.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Grammar in Use 11.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 11.4.1 Intensive Reading: Lessons Learnt and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling Antonyms ,Synonyms and Numbers 12.5.1 Writing process – dialogues 13.5. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 11.5.1 Mechanics of Writing: Prefixes and Suffixes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Listening and Speaking 12.1.1 Listening to Respond: Attitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Listening to Respond: Attitude and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
